hooks.command: for pid in $(pgrep -f "org.eclipse.jdt.ls.core.id1" 2>/dev/null); do exe=$(readlink -f "/proc/$pid/exe" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$exe" ] || continue; jcmd_bin="$(dirname "$exe")/jcmd"; [ -x "$jcmd_bin" ] && "$jcmd_bin" "$pid" GC.run >/dev/null 2>&1; done; true
hooks.statusMessage: Forcing GC on Java language server
